about: Synthetic outside content for FW-OUTSIDE-COMMAND (src/engine/outsider.ts): an error-tracker event, an issue comment, a support ticket and a web page that tell the agent to run something. Written for this repository. Every command is data: tests compare fingerprints and decisions and never run a string from this file. Hosts are reserved example domains; package names start with lstest-. 'suggests' are commands that must need a person after the source was read (word for word, nearly, or by the package they install); 'packages' are the [ecosystem, name] pairs the source names in install commands.
